name: com.farmfury.core
description: Shared code for every Farm Fury game: UI kit, effects and the shared menus (World/Level Select, Settings/Shop family, Pause, parental gate, Legal, New Character, World Unlocked, leaderboard page), ads (LevelPlay) and analytics wrappers, a Store facade and shop-promo pacing, utilities, GameIdentity. Edit only in the FarmFury_Shared repo; games receive it as a vendored copy via Tools/sync_shared.py.
